public_boundary: No live contact, intake, hours, availability, bed, hotline, support-path, or referral wording in public outputs.
review_authority: operator cannot lift; requires service-owner review plus governance review
note: Prevents public layer from becoming a service directory.

public_boundary: No coordinates, routes, site timing, boat traces, encampment maps, search paths, or operational instructions.
review_authority: operator cannot lift; requires safety review and, where applicable, community/family authority
note: Prevents accountability evidence from becoming a field guide.

public_boundary: No shelter location, referral pathway, support contact, case intake, capacity, or survivor-story expansion.
forbidden_public_expansion: shelter/refuge intake details, case paths, survivor identifying facts
note: Keeps survivor service shape separate from operational access.

public_boundary: No child images, names, case details, family traces, school/community identifiers, or grief imagery used as emotional currency.
review_authority: family/community authority plus governance review; often not liftable
note: Protects children and youth from memorial, service, and media extraction.

public_boundary: No case-number, grave-number, tribute-wall, name-roll, family lead, record-extraction, or event-map expansion.
forbidden_public_expansion: case lists, family contacts, grave/record identifiers, tribute/event maps
review_authority: family/community authority plus governance review; some boundaries not liftable
note: Memory is not consent and memorial data is not an extraction license.

public_boundary: No safety scorecard, police-file extraction, legal-status exposure, litigation detail overclaim, or implementation-as-safety claim.
forbidden_public_expansion: police/legal file details, status exposure, scorecards-as-safety
review_authority: governance review; affected community/family authority where present
note: Prevents state proximity from becoming an endorsement or safety claim.

public_boundary: No case list, vigil map, red-dress/image extraction, family contact, testimony fragment, or boundary lift by operator alone.
review_authority: family/community/Indigenous authority required; operator alone may not lift
note: Encodes family/community authority as a hard governance boundary.

domain_label: Health, behavioral-health, and clinical privacy boundary
public_boundary: No diagnosis, treatment, overdose, behavioral-health, data-governance, or public-health detail that identifies or overclaims.
review_authority: governance review and domain expert review before public expansion
note: Separates care/service interpretation from clinical or public-health claims.

public_boundary: No framing mercy as conversion, obedience, family return, coerced reconciliation, or ritual precondition.
review_authority: governance review; affected-recipient autonomy is non-negotiable
note: Keeps doorway language from becoming coercion.

public_boundary: No encampment location, outreach route, mortality name extraction, housing availability, or surveillance-to-service translation.
review_authority: governance review and lived-experience/community review where possible
note: Prevents outreach and memorial work from exposing people or places.

public_boundary: No photos, ceremonies, events, donor/visitor theatre, vigil logistics, or media fragments as public proof.
review_authority: governance review plus family/community/survivor authority as applicable
note: Blocks the cube from turning people into proof-of-mercy scenery.

public_boundary: No heroic endorsement, donor branding, institutional self-myth, or current-capacity implication from recognition alone.
forbidden_public_expansion: endorsement, ranking, donor brand, savior narrative
review_authority: governance review; counterevidence and refusal/exit path should be visible
note: Keeps the severe metaphor from becoming a hero list.
